mapper.select: SELECT site_id, site_name, site_url, status, is_default FROM cms_site ORDER BY is_default DESC, site_name ASC, site_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cms_site (site_id, site_name, site_url, status, is_default, updated_at) VALUES (#{siteId}, #{siteName}, #{siteUrl}, #{status}, #{defaultSite}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_site SET site_name = #{siteName}, site_url = #{siteUrl}, status = #{status}, is_default = #{defaultSite}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE site_id = #{siteId}

UPDATE cms_site SET is_default = FALSE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE is_default = TRUE
AND site_id <> #{excludeSiteId}
